hero.title: Reliable support for every recovery
hero.lead: For over two decades, Tianhong Medical has specialized in low-temperature thermoplastic immobilization and rehabilitation orthoses, serving 30+ countries and 400+ top-tier hospitals in China.

brands.title: Rehab & immobilization for every scenario
brands.subtitle: From post-op orthopedic rehab to radiotherapy positioning and pet rehabilitation — one material science, three professional fields.

card_1.title: Orthopedic Rehab Orthoses

card_2.title: Patient Immobilization
card_2.desc: Thermoplastic masks and fixation systems delivering reproducible positioning for precision radiotherapy.
